changelog_html:
1.4.1

  • The plugin now updates itself: WordPress checks the release manifest on GitHub and shows the standard update notice when a new version ships. Auto-updates can be enabled from the Plugins screen.

1.4.0

  • The Blue Henry results line states the monthly quantity ("6 lbs in 1 lb bags") so the total no longer reads as the price of a single bag.
  • The "Shop wholesale" button defaults to bluehenry.com/wholesale-ordering/.
